coupon.external_action: Requires a designated coupon/promotion provider partner.
coupon.summary: Not in this release — configuring it is refused.

internal_credit.summary: Double-entry credit into the internal reward ledger; fully in-repo.

loyalty_points.external_action: Requires a designated loyalty provider partner (commercial + integration).
loyalty_points.summary: Not in this release — configuring it is refused.

manual_approval.summary: Queues the reward for manual operator approval.

manual_export.summary: Produces a batch export row the tenant fulfils out-of-band.

onchain_claim.external_action: EVM mainnet real-value activation requires external contract audit evidence.
onchain_claim.summary: EVM oracle-signed claim proof; tenant/user submits the on-chain tx (Aether never submits or holds funds).

recommend_only.summary: Returns an eligibility recommendation; no delivery.

stripe_credit.external_action: Stripe live-mode credentials (test mode covered in sandbox).
stripe_credit.summary: Idempotent Stripe customer-balance credit via the tenant's Stripe key.

tenant_webhook.summary: Signed JSON delivery to the tenant's webhook via the durable outbox; HMAC secret from the credential authority.

x402_credit.external_action: External facilitator + funded RPC for live x402 verification.
x402_credit.summary: Reward action → x402 credit grant through the commerce control plane; sandbox-supported, no custody.
